Description.Name: Get Your Goat
Description.Details: You are making your way through one of the Argo's passageways when you find [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] waiting for you, his expression unusually serious. "Commander, I need to get back to Goatpath." Jarl folds his arms. "I need to find Sheila." You pause. "Sheila?" "My goat," Jarl replies. "My favorite goat. And before you ask, yes, this is important. I need her to perfect the ammunition for my Lutefisk Launcher." You stare at him for a moment. "Your ammunition requires a goat?" "Not just any goat, Commander. Sheila. Remember the strange wizard you rescued on Goatpath? The one who wanted a goat and a crate of lutefisk in exchange for introducing you to me?" You nod. "The same man. He is a dear friend and gave me the recipe himself. Specially fermented goat's milk, combined with prepared lutefisk according to his rather unusual instructions. The mixture can be refined into either smoke ammunition or BioGel acid ammunition. The proportions are precise, and Sheila's milk is essential. I received an HPG message from him and Sheila's missing." "I heard that part," Capt Jack says as he rounds the corner. Jarl immediately turns and grins. "Capt Jack." The two clasp hands in greeting with the easy familiarity of old friends. "Jarl," Jack replies. "I heard you were looking for Sheila. Still causing trouble, is she?" "Sheila's ran off again." "Sheila ate half my boots the last time I saw her." "You left them where she could reach them." Capt Jack turns toward you with a grin. "You see what I have to deal with, Commander?" "Unfortunately," you reply. Jack reaches into one of his pockets. "Speaking of old friends, MiG gave me an electronic whistle a while back. Remember that little thing?" Jarl nods. "I remember MiG nearly losing his shit after you started modifying it." Capt Jack looks mildly offended. "Improving it. There's a difference. I made a few modifications using components I acquired along the way," Capt Jack continues. "It can now broadcast several different signals and frequencies. If Sheila is anywhere nearby when we get to Goatpath, this should help you call her." Jarl takes the whistle and turns it over in his hand. "You actually made this useful?" "Occasionally I surprise people." "It also means you probably stole something important from someone." Capt Jack smiles. "Procured. And yes." You look between the two men. "You both know MiG, you're friends, and neither of you thought to mention any of this before now?" Jarl shrugs. "It never seemed important until Sheila went missing." "And now?" you ask. Jarl pockets the modified whistle. "Now it is extremely important. Once we reach Goatpath, this should help me find Sheila. After that, I can finally perfect the ammunition for the Lutefisk Launcher." Capt Jack's grin widens. "Still building that thing?" "Improving it," Jarl replies. "Twenty-five mortar tubes, custom-built from components taken from two-, four-, six-, and eight-tube mortars, all connected through a Scatter Fire Control System." Jack nods appreciatively. "And the ammunition?" "The recipe from my friend, the Wizard. Fermented goat's milk and lutefisk. Smoke ammunition when I want to blind an enemy. BioGel acid ammunition when I want them to remember me." You consider this information carefully. "So finding one missing goat is the key to finishing a twenty-five-tube lutefisk mortar launcher." Jarl nods. "Precisely." Capt Jack claps him on the shoulder. "Then we'd better get back to Goatpath and find Sheila." Jarl looks toward you expectantly.

Description.Name: Perhaps at a Later Time
Description.Details: You shake your head. "Not yet. We can't spare the time or the funds to make a trip to Goatpath right now." Jarl's expression falls, though he nods in reluctant understanding. "Then Sheila will have to wait a little longer." Capt Jack folds his arms. "Probably for the best. Finding one goat is only part of this operation anyway." You look toward Jarl. "What else do you need?" Jarl straightens. "Parts. The Lutefisk Launcher isn't complete yet. I still need mortar launcher components that can be adapted into the twenty-five-tube assembly, as well as an FCS Scatter system to coordinate the firing pattern. Without those components, finding Sheila only solves the ammunition problem." Capt Jack nods thoughtfully. "And knowing how Jarl builds things, some of those parts may not be easy to come by." Jarl ignores him. "We need time to find the proper components and funds to reach Goatpath. Until then, the project remains incomplete." You give the matter one final thought. "Then we wait. When we have the resources, we'll look for Sheila—and the parts you need." Jarl sighs and pockets the modified whistle. "Not yet, then. But eventually, Commander." Capt Jack grins. "The goat isn't going anywhere. Probably."

Description.Name: Let's Goat For it!
Description.Details: You look from Jarl to Capt Jack. "All right. Let's go for it. Set a course for Goatpath. We're going to find Sheila." Jarl breaks into a broad grin. "Excellent, Commander! Once we reach Goatpath, the whistle should help us locate her." Capt Jack nods approvingly. "And once we've found the goat, we've still got the other half of the problem." You raise an eyebrow. "The launcher parts?" Jarl nods. "Correct. Sheila provides the essential ingredient for the ammunition, but I still need components from existing mortar launchers to construct the Lutefisk Launcher itself. I can adapt parts from two-, four-, six-, or eight-tube mortar launchers, but I also require an FCS Scatter system and the appropriate [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[Lore_MortarCalibrator],Mortar Calibrator]] to coordinate all twenty-five tubes." Capt Jack smiles. "A twenty-five-tube mortar launcher built from whatever suitable mortar parts we can acquire and controlled by a Scatter Fire Control System. Sounds almost reasonable when you say it quickly." "It is perfectly reasonable," Jarl replies. You consider the growing list of requirements. First, travel to Goatpath. Find one missing goat. Then acquire enough components from existing mortar launchers to build a twenty-five-tube weapon system. Finally, locate an FCS Scatter system capable of controlling it, as well as a [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[Lore_MortarCalibrator],Mortar Calibrator]]. You look at Darius's future logistics report already forming in your imagination. "Fine. Set the course. First we find Sheila. After that, we start looking for the parts." Jarl grips the modified whistle. "Sheila first. The Lutefisk Launcher second." Capt Jack chuckles. "Commander, I'm fairly certain that's the first time in history that sentence has been used as an official operational plan." You turn toward the bridge. "Don't put that in the report." Capt Jack's grin widens. "Too late."
